footer_line: Sunmeld is made by ipe Studio:
journal_desc: Notes from the making of Sunmeld, a space merge duel against AI opponents.
home_desc: Sunmeld (Space Merge Duel) is a player-versus-AI merge duel for iOS and Android, now in development. Take turns dropping space stones into one shared tub, merge them into bigger worlds, and do not be the one who overflows it.
hero_lead: A merge duel against an AI opponent in one shared tub. Drop a stone, merge matching stones into the next stage, and score. Overflow the tub and you lose.
hero_note: In development. Free to try, one purchase unlocks everything, no ads.
board_aria: Illustration of a Sunmeld match: a shared tub holding space stones of several stages, with a new stone about to drop
card1_p: You and the AI take turns dropping a space stone into one shared tub. The stack you build is also the space your opponent plays in.
card2_p: When two stones of the same stage touch, they merge into the next stage, from dust up to a sun. The player who causes a merge scores it.
card3_p: If the tub overflows, the player who placed the last stone loses. Think about what you leave behind.
rivals_p: You always play against an AI opponent, and each one has its own habits, so the same tub plays out differently every time.
